1.
Learned Additional Government Advocate accepts notice for respondent.

2. The petitioner is before this Court seeking for the following reliefs:
"a) Issue writ of mandamus directing the respondent to consider the representation
dated 25.10.2022 as per Annexure-C, in respect of property of the petitioner, in the
interest of justice and equity.
b) Issue any writ or order or directions as this Hon'ble court deems fit in
circumstances of the case, in ends of justice and equity."
3.

The grievance of the petitioner is that though enhanced compensation has been paid as regards
Nc: 2024:Khc-K:6952
4.

similarly situated land acquired under the very same notification, the said enhanced
compensation has not been made available to the petitioner.
Gangamma W/O Marthand Died By Lrs 1) ... vs The State Of Karnataka on 13 September, 2024

Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5226540/
2

5.

Whenever any land is acquired and compensation is enhanced, it is required that all the land
losers also be made available the same compensation as held by this Court in MSA.No.200186/2019
disposed of on 11.02.2021.
6.

In that view of the matter, I pass the following:
Order
i) The Writ petition is allowed.
ii) A mandamus is issued directing the respondent to consider the representation of
the petition dated 25.10.2022 at Annexure-C by treating the same as an application
under Section 28A of the Land Acquisition Act.

Sd/-
